currentPhase.description: RC718 remains the frozen promoted legacy standalone product after RC719 PASS_WITH_RESERVATIONS. ARC-WP-021 clean break remains canonical. ARC-WP-022 accepts the learnit.kit.v2 foundation contract, isolated successor storage namespaces, a 32-file successor budget, a minimal QCM/fill vertical slice and a three-stream disjoint multi-AI model with later independent integration. Successor implementation remains blocked until ARC-WP-023 binds subordinate work packages to the exact ARC-WP-022 merge commit.

activeRisks.statement: The main-protection ruleset is configured but not enforced on this private personal-account repository.
activeRisks.closureGate: move the repository to an eligible GitHub Team organization account or another topology that enforces private-repository rulesets

activeRisks.statement: The accepted 32-file successor budget is intentionally narrow and may prove insufficient during implementation. Expanding it without a new decision would recreate the legacy growth pattern.
activeRisks.closureGate: implement the full foundation slice within the budget or obtain a separately reviewed file-budget amendment

activeRisks.statement: Python authoring and JavaScript runtime canonical JSON and SHA-256 implementations may disagree, invalidating otherwise sound packages.
activeRisks.closureGate: shared valid and invalid fixtures produce identical canonical bytes and digests in both implementations

activeRisks.statement: RC718 and the successor can share a browser origin, so storage isolation depends on strict namespace ownership and negative tests rather than browser process isolation.
activeRisks.closureGate: integrated browser tests prove RC718 localStorage and IndexedDB records remain byte-for-byte unchanged after successor boot, import, use and reset

activeRisks.statement: The clean-break decision intentionally does not migrate RC718 library or learner data. User confusion or perceived data loss is possible if the successor is distributed without explicit communication and preserved RC718 access.
activeRisks.closureGate: preserve retrievable RC718 access, publish an explicit rupture notice and pass a human release gate

activeRisks.statement: The RC719 promotion is recorded as accountable-owner PASS_WITH_RESERVATIONS without raw device recordings or per-case test logs.
activeRisks.closureGate: optional attachment of detailed human evidence or continued acceptance of owner attestation

activeRisks.statement: RC719 reservations remain unitemized, but they do not block a distinct clean generation and must not be silently copied into its scope.
activeRisks.closureGate: itemize only if RC718 maintenance or direct capability carry-forward is proposed

activeExceptions.rule: main branch protection must technically require pull requests and mandatory checks
activeExceptions.reason: The repository remains on the current private personal-account setup, where GitHub reports the configured ruleset as not enforced.
activeExceptions.expiryOrRemovalGate: repository plan or ownership topology change, serious governance bypass, or first external collaborator
activeExceptions.rollback: Remove this exception only after the repository reports the main-protection ruleset as enforced and a negative bypass test confirms the control.

nextMandatoryGate.condition: From the exact ARC-WP-022 merge commit, create and validate subordinate runtime, authoring, contradictory-QA/fixture and integration work packages whose writable paths exactly reproduce FILE_PLAN_V1.json. The first three roles may then start in parallel on independent branches or worktrees. The contract remains frozen, the integrator starts only from reviewed role outputs, and no RC718 compatibility, unplanned file or held platform domain may be introduced.
